from pathlib import Path
import math, struct, zlib

out = Path("D:/Project/Designers_Brain/research/agent-art/cards/_image_probes/p3_grok-imagine-image-edit/red_circle.png")
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
    size = 512
    img = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), "white")
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    d.ellipse([64, 64, size-64, size-64], fill=(220, 30, 30))
    img.save(out)
    print("PIL OK ->", out.resolve(), out.stat().st_size, "bytes")
except ImportError:
    # Manual PNG writer (no PIL): white bg, red circle with anti-aliasing-ish supersampling
    S = 512; R = 192.0; cx = cy = 256.0
    rows = []
    for y in range(S):
        row = bytearray([0])
        for x in range(S):
            # supersample 2x2
            hits = 0
            for dy in (0.25, 0.75):
                for dx in (0.25, 0.75):
                    if (x+dx-cx)**2 + (y+dy-cy)**2 <= R*R:
                        hits += 1
            a = hits / 4.0
            r = int(255*(1-a) + 220*a); g = int(255*(1-a) + 30*a); b = int(255*(1-a) + 30*a)
            row += bytes((r, g, b))
        rows.append(bytes(row))
    raw = b"".join(rows)
    def chunk(t, data):
        c = struct.pack(">I", len(data)) + t + data
        return c + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t + data) & 0xffffffff)
    png = (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
           + chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", S, S, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
           + chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
           + chunk(b"IEND", b""))
    out.write_bytes(png)
    print("manual PNG ->", out.resolve(), out.stat().st_size, "bytes")
